privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sB: Data Collection, Purpose and Legal Basis
privacy.sD: Data Sharing, International Transfers and Sub-processors

collection.intro: We collect and process your personal data only for explicit, lawful, and specific purposes.

row1.purpose: Contract performance, account management, service notifications

row2.purpose: Processing service fees, fulfilling accounting and tax obligations

row3.purpose: Monitoring platform security, improving service functionality, preventing fraud

processor.body: For end-customer personal data you upload to our platform, we act solely as a Data Processor, processing such data only on your documented instructions as the Controller. We do not use this end-customer data for any of our own purposes, and we are bound by the DPA signed with you.

sharing.subProcessors: Sub-processors — To provide the service, we share your data with third parties, including: cloud hosting: Cloudway and DigitalOcean.
sharing.intlTransfer: International Data Transfers — Because our hosting involves DigitalOcean (a U.S. company), your personal data may be transferred to countries outside the European Economic Area. We ensure the lawfulness of such transfers: the latest European Union Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) have been signed with the service providers.

rights.intro: As a data subject, you have the right to exercise the following rights with us:
rights.accessDesc: Obtain a copy of the data we hold about you
rights.rectificationDesc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
rights.erasureDesc: Request deletion of your personal data under specific conditions
rights.restrictionDesc: Request restriction of processing during dispute resolution
rights.portabilityDesc: Receive data you have provided to us in a structured format
rights.objectionDesc: Object to the processing of your personal data based on legitimate interests

retention.dataRetention: Data Retention — We retain your personal data only for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy.
retention.security: Security — We implement strict TOMS to protect your data from unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss.

gdpr.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
gdpr.subtitle: This agreement is an annex to the Master Service Agreement (MSA).

scope.purposeDesc: Providing loyalty program services through this platform, including creating, issuing, managing and storing membership cards, stamps, and transaction records.
scope.dataSubjectsDesc: The Controller's end customers (i.e., loyalty program members / participants).
scope.dataCategoriesDesc: Name, email address, phone number, member ID, transaction records, points history, etc.
scope.natureDesc: Collection, recording, storage, organization, analysis, retrieval, transmission and deletion.
scope.durationDesc: During the effective period of the master service agreement, and for 30 days after its termination.

processingOnly.title: Process Only Per Instructions
processingOnly.body: The Processor processes personal data only on the Controller's documented instructions.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.body: The Processor ensures that all personnel who access personal data have signed confidentiality agreements.

toms.title: Information Security Measures (TOMS)
toms.body: The Processor implements appropriate technical and organizational measures that meet the requirements of GDPR Article 32.

subProcessors.title: Sub-processors
subProcessors.existing: Existing sub-processors: Cloudway (hosting service) and DigitalOcean (cloud infrastructure).
subProcessors.new: New sub-processors: The Processor commits to giving the Controller a 30-day objection period.

assistance.title: Duty to Assist
assistance.dsr: Data Subject Rights (DSR): Assist in responding to end-customer requests to access, rectify, or erase their data.
assistance.dpia: Impact Assessment: Assist in conducting Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA).
assistance.breach: Breach Notification: Notify the Controller immediately upon discovering any data security incident.

termination.deletion: Service Termination Handling: Upon termination of the service, the Processor shall securely delete or return all copies of personal data.
termination.audit: Audit and Evidence: The Processor shall provide all necessary information to demonstrate compliance with this DPA.
